name: wa-tasks-plugin
description: Foundation plugin bundling Linear, Google Drive, Gmail, and Fathom connectors, and using whatever Basecamp MCP connector is already present. Includes a 15-5 weekly report skill that posts the report as a reply on a fixed Basecamp thread, a create-todos skill that turns 15-5 priorities into Basecamp todos, and a novo-weekly-readout skill that drafts the Novo weekly readout.
